label: request-level query parameters
type: settings supplied per request, overriding node- and cluster-level values for that request only
note: One of three tiers promoted together so the model is nameable rather than implied; see relations/requires-request-parameter. Round 15 folded `setting-scope:request-level` onto this id. The `setting-scope:` prefix was a three-member namespace minted by the same round-10 batch whose reconciliation promoted these three records - the frame was promoted and its own extraction ids were left behind under a second prefix, which is how a namespace comes to exist holding nothing but duplicates of promoted concepts.
